records.text: More tips at CandaceOwens.com. Thank you, Zach Costello, for putting this bee in my bonnet. I know you were thinking a different route, but I'm always like that Men in Black scene where like, you know, I go after the girl, there's all these aliens and my brain just works different way. And now this has to be solved.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
